content.title: Update webapp dev and validation ports
content.description:
Standardize the ports the webapp and its API server use across development and E2E/validation environments.

Target ports:
- Development: webapp (vite frontend) = 3000, API (hono server) = 3001
- Validation/E2E: webapp (vite frontend) = 5000, API (hono server) = 5001

Current state (to be changed):
- server/index.ts: defaults PORT to 3000 (dev API runs on 3000).
- frontend/vite.config.ts: apiPort defaults to '3000'; vitePort is only set when VITE_PORT is provided (dev vite falls back to its default 5173).
- playwright.config.ts: E2E API server on 3001, vite on 5174, baseURL http://localhost:5174; webServer env sets PORT=3001, VITE_PORT=5174, API_PORT=3001.

Expected changes:
- server/index.ts: default PORT 3000 -> 3001.
- frontend/vite.config.ts: default apiPort '3000' -> '3001'; make the dev vite port default to 3000 when VITE_PORT is not set (E2E still overrides via VITE_PORT=5000).
- playwright.config.ts: API webServer port 3001 -> 5001 (PORT=5001), vite port 5174 -> 5000 (VITE_PORT=5000, API_PORT=5001), baseURL -> http://localhost:5000. Update the explanatory comment that references '3001 backend, 5174 frontend'.
- package.json: update any scripts/docs that reference the old ports.
- docs and webapp expertise files (e.g. .agentic/expertise/webapp-validator/webapp-server-ports.expertise.md) that reference the old ports must be updated to keep guidance accurate.

This deliverable has NO new user-facing capability — it is infrastructure config.
